subject: Vendr onboarding: temporary credential proofs and authz checks
messages:
From: Lindsey Park <security@nimblebank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding checklist + temp creds request

Hi Sean,

Thanks for agreeing to go through our vendor onboarding. Attached is NimbleBank's security onboarding checklist — the items we need to verify in Vendr to complete the compliance review.

Top asks:
- Proof of ephemeral upload credentials (manifest + last-rotation timestamp)
- Evidence of S3 proof possession (sample snapshot or signed manifest)
- CAIQ/SIG assignment: confirm which fields are managed in Vendr vs. our questionnaire

Can you upload the listed artifacts to the Vendr evidence workspace and share links by EOD next Friday? If you prefer, we can accept a signed S3 snapshot (tar.gz) via the secure upload link below.

Attachment: nimblebank_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)
Secure upload: https://uploads.nimblebank.com/transfer/ea123

Thanks,
Lindsey Park
Security Manager | NimbleBank
lindsey@nimblebank.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Park <security@nimblebank.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:02:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding checklist + temp creds request

Hi Lindsey —

Appreciate the checklist. We're happy to get this over the finish line. Quick plan:

1) Mina will prepare a vendr_tempcreds_manifest.csv that documents the ephemeral credentials used for the S3 ingress and include rotation timestamps.
2) Kimberly will stage an S3 snapshot and produce a signed manifest that you can verify.
3) We'll upload artifacts to Vendr and share links and a crosswalk mapping Vendr fields to the NimbleBank CAIQ questions.

Can you confirm the TTL you require for the temp credentials (hours) and whether we should include KMS key IDs in the manifest? We'll default to 24 hours and include key metadata unless you specify otherwise.

I'll mark this as high priority — expected delivery Wed/Thu next week depending on internal rotations.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Lindsey Park <security@nimblebank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 14:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding checklist + temp creds request

Hi team,

I've attached the vendr_tempcreds_manifest.csv stub and a short README describing the fields. Notes:
- manifest columns: credential_id, issued_at, expires_at, scope, rotation_policy, kms_key_id (nullable)
- The ephemeral creds we use for vendor uploads are STS-based short-term tokens issued by our ingestion service; expires_at is typically issued_at + 24h.
- For proof of possession, I'm preparing an S3 proof snapshot; the snapshot will be uploaded to a signed bucket with a signed-manifest hash.

Question for NimbleBank: do you want the snapshot to include a sample log of the PUT operations (we can include a 24-hour activity slice) or just the object digests and manifest?

Attachment: vendr_tempcreds_manifest.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Park <security@nimblebank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding checklist + temp creds request

Hi Lindsey —

Following up with the artifacts we discussed.

Uploads & links:
- Vendr profile evidence workspace: https://app.vendr.co/orgs/789/evidence (permission: nimblebank-security@nimblebank.com)
- S3 snapshot (signed): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcd/view?usp=sharing (s3-proof-snapshot.tar.gz)
- Vendr temp creds manifest: vendr_tempcreds_manifest.csv (attached)

What we included:
- Signed manifest with SHA256 digests for each uploaded object
- Rotation timestamps and KMS key metadata (where applicable)
- CAIQ/Vendr crosswalk document is in the Vendr workspace under 'NimbleBank / CAIQ-crosswalk'

Please confirm receipt and whether NimbleBank needs the additional PUT log slice. Happy to escalate a short sandbox session to replay a sample upload if that helps verification.

Attachments: vendr_tempcreds_manifest.csv (csv), s3-proof-snapshot.tar.gz (tar.gz)

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
